## La clase anterior...

<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; justify-content:center; margin-top:20px;">

<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="1" style="background:#a78bfa; color:white; border-radius:12px; padding:16px 28px; font-size:22px; width:280px; text-align:center;">
<strong>Prob. Condicional</strong><br>
$P(A \mid B) = \dfrac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$<br>
<em>Reduce el espacio muestral</em>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="2" style="background:#3b82f6; color:white; border-radius:12px; padding:16px 28px; font-size:22px; width:320px; text-align:center;">
<strong>Regla Multiplicación</strong><br>
$P(A \cap B) = P(A\mid B)\cdot P(B)$<br>
<em>Eventos secuenciales</em>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="3" style="background:#59A14F; color:white; border-radius:12px; padding:16px 28px; font-size:22px; width:320px; text-align:center;">
<strong>Independencia</strong><br>
$P(A \cap B) = P(A)\cdot P(B)$<br>
<em>Sin influencia mutua</em>
</div>

<div class="fragment fade-in" data-fragment-index="4" style="background:#F28E2B; color:white; border-radius:12px; padding:16px 28px; font-size:22px; width:320px; text-align:center;">
<strong>Prob. Total</strong><br>
$P(A) = \sum_i P(A\mid B_i)P(B_i)$<br>
<em>Combinar particiones</em>
</div>

</div>
